subject: Private Offer - invoice routing & partner credit mapping
messages:
From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@acmecorp.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <finops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer - invoice routing & partner credit mapping

Hi Laura,

Thanks for getting the private offer set up. Finance Ops has a couple of downstream requirements before we can finalize the PO and wiring instructions:

1) Invoice mapping — we need a CSV that maps Redwood invoice line items to our internal GL codes. Can you confirm whether Redwood's seller invoice will include a separate line for the marketplace fee vs. core seats, or if it's a single combined line?

2) Partner credit routing — our reseller (CloudPartners LLC) expects the channel credit to be routed either (a) via a marketplace passback line on the invoice, or (b) via a separate rebate invoice from Redwood. Which flow do you support for AWS private offers?

3) Billing contact & Docusign — please confirm the billing contact for the contract signature and whether you'll accept a DocuSign envelope for the SOW.

We’ve attached an example invoice mapping template from our AP team (attached). If you can send a short note describing the supported routing options and a sample invoice line layout, we can share with our CFO and get the PO out this week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Dunn
Senior Procurement Manager, AcmeCorp

Attachment: example_invoice_map.csv (CSV template from AcmeCorp AP)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@acmecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, Finance Ops <finops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer - invoice routing & partner credit mapping

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

- Invoice lines: Redwood can produce a seller invoice with separate lines (e.g., "Private Offer - Core Units", "Marketplace Fee / Channel Credit") so you can map each line to separate GL codes.
- Partner credit routing: we support both marketplace passback (recommended for speed) and a rebate invoice issued to CloudPartners LLC. For AWS private offers we typically do passback, but rebate invoicing is doable if your partner needs a separate legal invoice for accounting.
- Billing contact & DocuSign: Billing contact is billing@redwood.ai; we accept DocuSign.

Details:
- Example invoice layout we can generate:
  * Line 1: RDW Private Offer - Subscription (SKU: RDW-CORE-BASE) — quantity, unit price, extended amount
  * Line 2: RDW Marketplace Fee (SKU: RDW-MKT-CH) — negative line for passback / channel credit (if passback flow) or zero if handled by rebate invoice
  * Line 3: Taxes & service fees (as applicable)

If you prefer the rebate invoice flow, Redwood will issue a separate invoice to CloudPartners LLC with a description "Channel credit for AcmeCorp private offer RDW-2028-ACME-137" and the agreed negative amount. We will need partner legal name, tax ID, and billing address to issue that invoice.

I’ve attached a brief mapping example that shows how our two-line approach maps to common GLs — see attached.

Next steps:
- If you want marketplace passback, confirm AP will accept a negative marketplace line on the Redwood seller invoice and provide PO number + GL mapping.
- If rebate invoice is required, send partner legal info and we’ll draft the rebate invoice; note this adds an extra settlement step (net-30 from invoice date).

Looping in Ben for the channel waterfall comments and Irene for the tax/accounting impact.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: example_invoice_map.csv (Redwood sample completed mapping)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@acmecorp.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer - invoice routing & partner credit mapping

Alex / Laura —

Thanks — adding the proposed channel credit waterfall so you can see how the passback vs rebate flows affect nets to CloudPartners:

Proposed waterfall (illustrative):
- List price subscription: $100,000
- Redwood private-offer discount: 20% => $80,000 (seller invoice line: RDW-CORE-BASE $80,000)
- Marketplace fee set aside (passback) 10% of list => $10,000 shown as separate marketplace credit line on seller invoice (negative)
- Net to Redwood after passback = $70,000 (before tax)

If rebate invoice flow is used:
- Seller invoice will show only the net subscription ($80,000) without a marketplace negative line. Redwood then issues a separate rebate invoice for $10,000 to CloudPartners LLC. Accounting impact: payment and settlement timing depends on partner receivable terms; typical Redwood net-30 on rebate invoice.

Observations / ask:
- For cash-flow speed a marketplace passback keeps everything on a single settlement path and reduces AR cycles for your partner.
- If AcmeCorp requires a partner-level invoice for recognition or tax reporting, we can do the rebate route but we’ll need partner legal details and agree rebate payment timing.

I attached a quick workbook with sample numbers and a field mapping sketch for AP. Let me know which flow you prefer and I’ll update the invoice template accordingly.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Channel Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: channel_waterfall_v1.xlsx

From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@acmecorp.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, Finance Ops <finops@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer - invoice routing & partner credit mapping

Laura / Ben —

Thanks for the clear options and the workbook. AcmeCorp will take the marketplace passback approach — AP confirmed they can accept a negative marketplace line on the Redwood invoice which simplifies our close.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll circulate this to our CFO and route the PO. Expect PO # ACME-987654 by end of day tomorrow.
- Billing contact: billing@acme-finance.com (please use this for the final invoice).
- Please confirm the exact invoice line descriptions you will print so we can map GL codes in our system.

Also: we can sign by DocuSign — I’ll send the envelope once I receive the final contract from your side. Please confirm the DocuSign envelope should go to contracts@redwood.ai or directly to laura_bennett@redwood.ai.

Thanks — Alex
